name: smwmusic-la-mulana-inferno
title: La-Mulana - Inferno
description:
A port of the theme that plays in the Inferno Caverns of La-Mulana. Good for cave and lava levels.

This port is based on the SC-88 arrangement of the theme, but has customizable pitches to match all three versions found in game:
0 - G Minor, SC-88 pitch
1 - G Sharp Minor - SSCC pitch
2 - A Minor, La-Mulana Remake pitch
